slug: 2025-05-20 African nations making digital ID gains in the face of common challenges (ID4Africa 2025)

facts.fact: The Houwiyeti digital ID and digital-government platform, launched in 2023, handles 70 percent of passport requests, per the ANRPTS director at ID4Africa 2025.
Houwiyeti is used for passport requests and for more than 622,000 document extracts processed in the year.

MRT.note: The document states no exchange between civil register and ID system.

facts.fact: More than 94 percent of the population is enrolled for national ID since the new system of 2020, per the ANRPTS director.

MRT.note: The document says nothing of a number at birth.
The document does not say who operates or maintains the system.
The document names no register keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: A new national ID system, SIGPTS, integrating all government structures that issue ID documents, has been in place since 2020 and has enrolled over 94 percent of the population.
